pairs.subject: recruiting-funnel-metrics
pairs.evidence: app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsOfferLegPanel.tsx:73 The 'Awaiting response' count is offerConversion's `pending = max(0, extended - resolved)` (app/_lib/analytics-offer.ts:56), computed from per-kind windowed event counts (a transition-dated basis), yet it renders as a link to the board's offer column, so the link opens the current stock of offer holders, a different number of people from the net flow it shows.

techniques.evidence: app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsOfferLegPanel.tsx:69 max(extended, resolved) does bound the rate, but on a transition-dated window 'extended minus resolved' is a net flow, not outstanding offers; the technique names linking it to the offer holders as a failure. The 'basis' line also prints the max-substituted figure as '{extended} offers extended'.

app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsStatCluster.tsx:58 The headline speed figure is a lone mean (it does name its sample count), it feeds a delta (line 71), and it is judged against a goal chip. The technique says median for the typical case and never a mean as the input to a difference; the label also states neither anchor.

app/features/insights/analytics/stageDwellGate.ts:120 An occupants-only pair (median plus oldest), labelled as waiting right now (copy: 'everyone sitting in each stage right now'). No median below the sample floor; colour only against a team-set cadence; terminal role exempt (line 99).
